title: Robustness
summary: Why do vision models fail under adversarial and natural distribution shifts when humans don't? We study the features models rely on, such as texture versus shape, and how those choices create vulnerabilities.

title: Interpretability
summary: We compare how humans and machine learning models see the world, using tools from interpretability and human-alignment to explain what models learn and where their perception diverges from ours.

title: Security
summary: We evaluate and harden AI/ML systems against attackers, from mapping the space of adversarial strategies to uncovering backdoors and other threats in real-world deployments.
